name: README.TXT
content: You are the only sysadmin on site between 22:00 and 06:00.
Keep the mainframe alive. Recover what you can.
Some files have Bit Rot. Open them and line the bits back up
using SHIFT LEFT, SHIFT RIGHT and XOR. Every move costs you.
Shift+click   select a range of files
Ctrl+click    add or remove one file
Shift+drag    move a group of desktop icons
Start with PAYROLL.DAT. Accounts says it has been 'acting up'.
